# Ideaverse

In Nick Milo's usage, an ideaverse is the universe of ideas between your brain and everything around it, and more specifically your collection of digitally linked notes. It covers every place you find and develop ideas, whether for the world or for future you.

According to Milo, the value of an ideaverse comes from the frameworks of Linking Your Thinking (LYT), which add an optional layer for writing, thinking and navigating. He says it benefits people who think and write a lot, including students, academics, creators, writers and life designers. He defines ideas as solutions to problems or new insights built on earlier work.

Milo's own reasons for keeping notes: not forgetting, making sense of experience, referencing past thoughts, connecting ideas across domains, developing them over time and sharing them. He warns that an unreliable library is close to "digital dementia". The kit that illustrates this is described in Ideaverse Lite (kit).
